the httpclient (and therefore fcrepo-camel) does not do preemptive authentication by default. That is, (when authN is enabled) it first tries to execute a request without authN; if it fails, it reissues the request.

The problem with PUT/PATCH/POST requests in the context of fcrepo-camel is that they typically operate on streams. The first (unauthenticated) request will then consume the stream while the second (authenticated) request will no longer be able to access that data. This can be fixed by using preemptive authN, as is currently done in the camel-http4 component.

comments.body: The camel-http4 code for preemptive authentication is defined here: http://git.io/vcNI2

Looks like we can just use that interceptor directly. See https://github.com/daniel-dgi/fcrepo-camel/commit/f1ae38291ff985d0649e50bc181c04bf8412c726

Right now the interceptor gets added whenever the user supplies credentials. Is there a scenario where you would want to supply creds but not have pre-emptive auth?

I tested on a brand new fcrepo-vagrant using https://gist.github.com/daniel-dgi/85d270cd3a664787b444 and all seems well. Also threw the configuration from that file into https://github.com/daniel-dgi/fcrepo-camel-workshop/blob/master/06-ThumbnailGenerator.xml and all worked well.

Yes, that looks correct. We'll wait for the next development cycle to merge. Could you also add an integration test for this? In principle, it would be a matter of adding some additional config/spring/web.xml files in ./src/test/resources. Most of these files could be taken from the fcrepo-webapp-plus project.

I think the existing integration tests should stay as they are, but adding another one or two with a ContextConfiguration set to, e.g., spring-test/test-auth-container.xml would be great. E.g. FcrepoPutAuthIT.java – basically the same as the existing FcrepoPutIT.java but using a webac-based container.
Also, can you click the "Start Work" button in jira?

Still have no 'Start Work' button. Been a weird recurring issue with Jira. At one point Andrew Woods sorted it out, but now the button's gone again

Good to know that's I'm on the right path. I'll ping you if I've got questions about the tests.

Ok, strike that about the start work button. It's magically back again after making that last comment? Or I'm taking crazy pills.
